svg.text: The official flag is the wrong instrument, not only the wrong metric
HKO Headquarters vs ERA5-Land at the same Hong Kong coordinate, 2013–2023. Exposure identification only. No hospital counts. Live paper stays on Headquarters.
Slope = 0.0453 (SE 0.0074). HKO positive in 57 months; ERA5 in 9.
Same-cut Jaccard 0.031 at 28°C. Max vs fixed HKO 28°C set: 0.471 at 26.3°C. Count match 26.4°C is not the nights.

Guo et al. 2024: the official 28°C day-flag was a poor hospitalisation metric next to hourly excess. Mistry et al. 2022: ERA5-Land means usually travel for mortality curves, with weaker heat tails in the tropics.
This page: the flag also fails as a reanalysis object at the grain of the CHD/HF panel. Do not treat 0.045 as a health attenuation factor.
Not form 2a. Not Gate 3. Not a second health paper. Rebuild: python3 scripts/56_email_b_composite.py after scripts 53 and 54.
